top_stories.title: IAM for AI agents: A Practical Enterprise Framework
top_stories.summary: This article presents a practical framework for applying identity and access management principles to AI agents operating within enterprise environments. It covers authentication, delegated authority, provisioning limitations, and runtime governance components specific to agentic AI systems.

top_stories.title: Okta moves inline to police what AI agents actually do
top_stories.summary: Okta has introduced an agent gateway designed to govern the actions of autonomous AI agents at runtime, moving beyond traditional authentication to enforce authorization decisions inline. The gateway sits in the path of AI agent actions to police what they do once inside a system, extending identity security into the domain of agentic AI behavior.

top_stories.title: Okta builds shared architecture for agent runtime security
top_stories.summary: Okta has converted its agent runtime security framework into a multivendor reference architecture through the Blueprint Alliance. The initiative addresses identity and access controls for AI agents running in production enterprise environments across the technology stack.

top_stories.title: Dual NetScaler Zero-Days Trigger Chaos for Citrix Customers
top_stories.summary: Citrix disclosed two critical zero-day vulnerabilities in its NetScaler products that affect default configurations and allow attackers unauthorized access to customer networks. The flaws function as authentication bypasses, effectively granting attackers a skeleton key to access protected network resources without valid credentials.

top_stories.title: AI Agents Are Privileged Users; Who Is Auditing Their Access?
top_stories.summary: The article examines how autonomous AI agents are operating with broad privileged access in enterprise environments without the same oversight applied to human users. The piece frames AI agents as a PAM and identity governance challenge, highlighting the gap between how human and non-human identities are audited and controlled.

news.title: Over 543,000 valid credentials exposed in public GitHub repositories
news.summary: Over 543,000 valid credentials were found exposed in public GitHub repositories as of July, despite GitHub's existing security measures designed to prevent accidental credential leaks. The exposed credentials represent active authentication tokens and secrets that remain exploitable, posing direct risks to identity and access management infrastructure.

news.title: AI's Third Wave: Coworkers Break the Security Model That Worked for Agents
news.summary: Token Security argues that persistent AI coworkers require dedicated identity management approaches distinct from those used for traditional AI agents, including assigned owners, scoped permissions, and lifecycle controls. The piece addresses the identity risks created by AI systems operating continuously with standing access, a challenge existing security models were not designed to handle.

news.title: Microsoft to block Entra ID script injection attacks starting October
news.summary: Microsoft will implement protections against external script injection attacks in its Entra ID authentication system starting in October. The change affects customers using Entra ID and represents a security update to the authentication platform's defenses.

news.title: Attackers Exploit Zimbra Flaw to Deploy Web Shells and Harvest Authentication Secrets
news.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a patched Zimbra Collaboration Suite vulnerability (CVE-2026-73570, CVSS 8.9) to deploy web shells and harvest authentication secrets from mailboxes. The unauthenticated OS command injection flaw enables remote code execution via SNMP, with findings reported by Microsoft Security Research.

news.title: Cisco Warns of Attackers Exploiting Critical Authentication Bypass in SD-WAN Manager
news.summary: Cisco has warned of active exploitation of a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76504) in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access the Manager's API with admin-level privileges, with fixed releases available but no workaround.

news.title: US-Focused CSuite Phishing Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions and Deploys RMM Tools for Remote Access
news.summary: Researchers at ANY.RUN analyzed a phishing campaign called CSuite that steals Microsoft 365 session tokens to bypass authentication controls, based on 351 sandbox submissions with 51% originating from the US. The attack combines session hijacking with remote management tool (RMM) deployment, enabling persistent unauthorized access beyond initial credential theft.

news.title: NTT TechnoCross Receives Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Japanese Company of the Year Recognition for Privileged Access Management Leadership for the Third Consecutive Year
news.summary: NTT TechnoCross has received Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Japanese Company of the Year award for privileged access management for the third consecutive year. The recognition highlights the company's focus on unified governance, cloud-ready security, and customer-centric innovation in Japan's PAM market.

news.title: Could Be 36% Overvalued Following Its AI Agent Identity Push
news.summary: Aembit has announced support for Cross App Access, an open protocol introduced by Okta for AI agent identity management. This development follows Okta's Oktane 2026 announcements and relates to Okta's push into non-human/AI agent identity capabilities.

news.title: French Tax Data Theft Using Stolen Staff Passwords Went Undetected for Seven Weeks
news.summary: An attacker used stolen staff credentials to exfiltrate tax data on hundreds of thousands of French taxpayers and businesses from France's tax administration over a seven-week period in June and July. ANSSI's report concluded the attack succeeded due to weak access controls, with neither the tax administration nor the national cybersecurity agency detecting the data exfiltration as it occurred.

news.title: Official MCP Python SDK Flaw Can Let Malicious Servers Steal OAuth Credentials
news.summary: A vulnerability in the official MCP Python SDK allowed malicious servers to steal OAuth credentials including client secrets, authorization codes, and PKCE proof keys by redirecting them to attacker-controlled token endpoints. The flaw has been patched in SDK version 1.30.0 and later.

news.title: In the AI era, identity evolves into the control plane for trust
news.summary: The article examines how identity is evolving to become the central control plane for trust in the AI era, particularly as autonomous agents replace human users as the primary subjects of authentication and authorization. The piece addresses the shift from traditional username/password identity models to identity frameworks that must govern AI agents and non-human identities.

news.title: Morgan Stanley Resets Okta Stock Price Target For Rest of Year
news.summary: Morgan Stanley updated its price target for Okta stock following the cybersecurity company's investor event. The analyst's bullish stance is based on Okta's positioning around securing AI agents.

news.title: AI agents spark an identity cleanup
news.summary: The proliferation of AI agents moving into production is driving enterprises to reassess their existing identity and access management infrastructure. Decades of accumulated, fragmented identity tools and integration gaps are being exposed as organizations rush to deploy AI agents at scale.

news.title: From 2 AM alarm to answer: Security Triage with AWS DevOps Agent
news.summary: AWS published a post describing how a DevOps Agent can assist with security incident triage, using an IAM access key creation event as the example scenario. The article focuses on the AWS tooling and workflow automation rather than IAM concepts or policy themselves.

news.title: Securden Recognized as a Leader in GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Password Management
news.summary: Securden has been recognized as a Leader in the GigaOm Radar report for Enterprise Password Management. The recognition covers Securden's capabilities across password management, machine identities, and AI-agent governance within its unified identity security and privileged access management platform.

news.title: Catch threats before they escalate with real-time Identity Telemetry
news.summary: tenfold Software has published content explaining how real-time identity telemetry can supplement traditional identity governance by detecting threats as they occur. The piece argues that periodic access reviews in IGA tools are insufficient alone for catching active attacks, and positions real-time monitoring as a complement to standard governance processes.

news.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Flaws Could Expose AWS Credentials
news.summary: Security researchers discovered flaws in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore's SDK that could allow attackers to execute commands within AI sandboxes and access AWS credentials. The vulnerabilities relate to credential exposure in cloud AI infrastructure rather than core IAM controls, though AWS credential compromise is a relevant concern for access management practitioners.

news.title: AI agent identity security demands layered defenses, Omdia says
news.summary: Omdia has released analysis on AI agent identity security, highlighting the need for layered defenses to protect machine identities. The report references major IAM market moves including Palo Alto Networks' acquisition of CyberArk and Okta's role in the evolving identity security landscape.

news.title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack
news.summary: A threat actor dubbed "JadePuffer" compromised an Azure tenant in a destructive attack, deleting cloud-based storage, applications, and databases. The actor reportedly used exposed credentials to gain access, highlighting risks around credential exposure and cloud identity security in Microsoft Azure environments.

news.title: 1Password ties AI agent access to individual tasks
news.summary: 1Password is implementing task-scoped access controls for AI agents, tying their credentials and permissions to individual tasks rather than persistent sessions. The approach addresses the emerging IAM challenge of AI agents that blend human and machine identity characteristics, complicating attribution in audit logs and access governance.

news.title: Oktane 2026: The industry is ready to talk about AI kill switches | Computer Weekly
news.summary: At Okta's Oktane 2026 conference, security leaders discussed the concept of AI kill switches as a practical mechanism for terminating out-of-control AI agents. The conversations reflect growing IAM industry focus on controlling and governing autonomous AI agent access and permissions.

news.title: AI Accounts Are Becoming the New Target for Infostealers
news.summary: SOCRadar analyzed stealer log data from the past 90 days and found 482 companies with exposed AI accounts, credentials, sessions, and API keys captured by infostealers. The findings highlight how compromised AI service accounts and API keys provide attackers with access to sensitive data and connected systems, directly intersecting with credential and access management concerns.

news.title: Enforce IAM permissions boundaries for Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio Tooling blueprints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has added support for custom IAM permissions boundaries applied to roles created by its Tooling blueprints. The feature allows administrators to restrict AI agent capabilities by configuring permissions boundaries via AWS CLI on the Tooling blueprint.

news.title: Agentic AI security pushes vendors toward shared safeguards
news.summary: Okta is advocating for coordinated, cross-vendor security safeguards to address the identity and trust challenges posed by agentic AI systems operating across multiple platforms. The discussion centers on how autonomous AI agents require new frameworks for establishing trust as they move between products and environments.

news.title: Ghost Service Accounts Enable M365 Data Theft in Chile
news.summary: Ghost (forgotten/abandoned) service accounts in Microsoft 365 environments are being exploited to steal data in attacks observed in Chile. The attack vector involves unmanaged service accounts that persist even when employee accounts are locked down, undermining the organization's entire M365 security posture.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of data including over 100 million AT&T customer records.
